blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Most developers hate debugging; it's more fun to create bugs than to correct them.
exercises.ru: Большинство разработчиков ненавидят стадию отладки; ___ интереснее баги писать, чем исправлять.
exercises.why: «The adverbs здесь (here), там (there), дома (at home) indicate location and answer the question где … сюда (here), туда (there), домой (home) indicate direction and answer the question куда.» — DLI, Lesson 19. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
